system.longDesc:
This standard light armor sees use among many civilian security and police forces in crowd control situations. It consists of bullet-resistant armored plates for the chest, thighs, and shins, plus a helmet with face guard. The armor is commonly paired with riot shields and stun batons, collectively called riot gear. The helmet incorporates a radio and speakers. Weak points on this armor include the throat and the inner thigh.

Armor bonus +5, armor penalty -3, Income TN 13.
